content.overview: Section 197 caps total managerial remuneration and requires member or special-resolution approval above stated percentages, read with Schedule V.
content.glance: Section 197 caps total managerial remuneration and requires member or special-resolution approval above stated percentages, read with Schedule V.
content.study: The overall cap is 11 per cent of net profits unless a special resolution, and the rules in force, allow more. Individual ceilings apply to managing and whole-time directors and to other directors. No-profit or inadequate-profit cases follow Schedule V or Central Government approval. Sitting fees are outside the percentage computation as provided. Recovery of excess remuneration is in s. 197.
